caption: Trajan's Column, Rome
composition: Marble spiral victory column with continuous relief in Trajan’s Forum · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The column rises in the center-right of the frame, its marble shaft wound with the continuous spiral relief up to the statue crowning the top. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 13:21 Europe/Rome: clear midday sun under a deep blue sky.
